posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked:
While the usefuless of any individual promo hero would always depend on the specific situation, which promo versions are ones that you generally pick over the base hero? Or are there known situations when you'd always pick a promo over the base?

SS Tachyon and TL Tachyon seem obviously better than base Tachyon most of the time

F6 Absolute Zero's Elemental Wrath helps get past the slow starts he can often have

F6 Tempest's Sacrifice is pretty good as his base power isn't generally relevant once he gets the hailstorm

I find Young Legacy works better than Legacy in fights with only three heroes

Most of the other promos I either haven't played with enough to get a feel for when or why they might be better or I find that their variant power isn't notably more useful than their base power (e.g. the GI Bunker & RC Wraith powers can be useful in some situations, but I generally find I'm using other powers for those heroes anyway)

posts.name: Killswitch
posts.cooked:
Off the top of my head, I've grown a liking to DW Nightmist, TL/SS Tachyon, and occasionally Young Legacy.

DW Nightmist lets you plan her spell plays out better, and saves you from burning yourself. So you onlt take self-damage when you're using spells, and not her base power.

Team Leader Tachyon for obvious ridiculous draw power reasons. SS Tachyon because I feel it's a good way to mill Bursts while occasionally getting lucky enough to play them. A bit of a luck factor, but it suits my play style more than base Tachyon.

I usually prefer base Legacy because bolstering all instances of damage helps tremendously against DR. Young Legacy switches your playstyle a lot, thus making cards like Surge of Strength more useful, since you're doing more damage than you are buffing. Plus, 3 damage for a base power is nothing to sneeze at. Unless you're allergic to being awesome.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Foote:

Redeemer Fanatic over base Fanatic any day of the week folks.

And we all get to see the incredible wrongness that is Foote's thoughts on Fanatic.  Seriously.  He's so very nice and seems like a smart person, I just don't get it.

 

Anyways, here are my thoughts:

AZ:   Elemental Wraith,  Healing is overrated.

Bunker:  EOW Bunker, Having a situaltional "OMG get rid of that card now" power is great.

Fanatic:  Original.  Foote is wrong, healing is overrated, do some freaking damage.

Haka:  Prime Warden.  It's not ridiculously powerful, it's just insanely cool.  (and when LSB hits 50 damage you know you are doing it right)

Legacy:   Young Legacy, feels like it fits the deck better than Galvanize, and it isn't like her being ridiculously strong is a change from her Dad.

Ra:  Original.  What are you going to do with all those cards?  He doesn't need them.

Tachyon:  Original:  I love SST, but I think the deck is more dynamic with that base power.  It just feels right.  SST your hand feels irrelevant, and TLT is just sick.  She's in the Dark Visionary category of revenge games and special shallenges only.

Tempest:  Original, you have better ways to draw cards, although I need to play PW Tempest more, that one might be good.

Visionary:  Original, Dark is just too dominant.

Wraith:   RC Wraith , to parrot earlier commentor,   is really cool.  Some environments not as much, but there are those that are well worth it.

Fixer:  Original, I really don't liek DW Fixer.  My playstyle loves regular Fixer, and DW is like trying to fix something that was awesome.

Expat:  Push.  I like original for Unload and DW for gunless moments.  Otherwise I never use her base power.

Nightmist:   DW Nightmist, huge props for breaking a really cool character out of being a high school economics lesson.

Argent:  Original, the new one is really fun, but also insanely powerful, the PW one I need to play more, but I'm not the biggest fan of all the new card play shenanigans.

Omnitron-X:  Fan Made Omnitron XI:  select a component, that component acts at the end of the turn as well.  I find it a lot more fun.

Unity:  Golem Unity, who needs health anyway?

KNYFE:  Rogue Agent, I know I said I don't like all this new fangled card play, but KNYFE it really works, makes you use her cool powers with the costs more.  I really like this card.

Setback:  Regular, he isn't so powerful that he needs a nerfed version, and losing tokens is just harsh for a base power.
